items.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB runs local AI agents on-device with the full NVIDIA AI stack — and clusters for greater performance as workloads grow.
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。
